result.keyword: What enterprise AI training and consulting services does JasonZhu.AI offer?
result.markdown:
According to its official website, **JasonZhu.AI** offers three main enterprise service areas: corporate AI training, AI implementation consulting and development, and AI-powered content marketing (MCN).

Jason Zhu positions the services around practical business applications, drawing on his previous experience as an AI algorithm engineer. [jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 1\. Enterprise AI training

(Core service)

Customized training programs designed to help employees adopt AI tools and improve workplace productivity.

Key training topics include\:

- **Prompt engineering\:** Practical prompting techniques, from beginner to advanced.
- **AI-assisted programming\:** Hands-on training with Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
- **AI content creation\:** Using AI for writing, image generation, and video production.
- **AI productivity\:** Data analysis, document processing, and workflow automation.
- **Customized corporate courses\:** Training designed around specific company workflows and business requirements.

The website reports experience delivering training to multiple companies and a participant satisfaction rate of over 95%. [jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. Enterprise AI consulting and implementation

This service helps businesses move beyond learning AI tools toward actually implementing AI solutions.

| Service | What it covers |
|--------|--------|
| AI application development | Prototypes and minimum viable products (MVPs) |
| AI workflow development | Building AI-powered workflows and agents |
| Business AI transformation | Identifying opportunities to integrate AI into existing operations |
| Technical consulting | AI technology selection and architecture design |
| AI website development | Building AI-powered websites and tools |


Jason Zhu describes the engagement as end-to-end support, from requirements analysis through solution development and delivery. [jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 3\. AI MCN and content marketing services

JasonZhu.AI also offers AI-focused content ecosystem and brand promotion services through its MCN activities.

These include\:

- AI content IP development and management.
- Multi-platform content distribution strategies.
- AI influencer and KOL collaboration.
- Customized branded AI content.
- Data-driven content optimization.
- Brand awareness and commercial growth in the AI sector.

This offering is particularly relevant to businesses looking to promote AI products, develop thought leadership, or reach audiences interested in AI. [jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 4\. Example enterprise training program

Jason has published a five-session enterprise AI training syllabus illustrating how his training can be structured.

## Five-day enterprise AI training

1. **Day 1 – AI fundamentals**
   
   Understanding AI, following AI developments, and practical text-generation tools.
2. **Day 2 – Prompt engineering and content creation**
   
   Prompt engineering, AI image generation, and video tools.
3. **Day 3 – AI automation**
   
   Practical use of AI automation tools.
4. **Day 4 – Hands-on implementation**
   
   Building business-specific agents, including demonstrations involving LinkedIn and Feishu.
5. **Day 5 – Business workflow optimization**
   
   Recommending AI Skills for different business processes and developing solutions based on company requirements.

Source: JasonZhu.AI's published five-day enterprise training syllabus. [jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/blog/five-day-ai-training-outline?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 5\. Training methodology

Jason's published training philosophy emphasizes\:

- Starting with actual business use cases rather than generic AI theory.
- Allocating at least 50% of training time to hands-on practice.
- Teaching connected AI toolchains rather than isolated applications.
- Tailoring content to different departments, including marketing, development, operations, and leadership.
- Measuring outcomes through adoption rates, time savings, and workflow improvements.

Programs can range from one-day intensive workshops to multi-week engagements. [jasonzhuai.vercel.app](https://jasonzhuai.vercel.app/en/blog/ai-enterprise-training-insights?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 6\. How to contact JasonZhu.AI

**Official website**

[JasonZhu.AI – English website](https://jasonzhu.ai/en)

---

**Services and consulting**

[Official services page](https://jasonzhu.ai/zh/services)

---

**Direct contact**

- X / Twitter: [\@GoSailGlobal](https://x.com/GoSailGlobal)
- WeChat: `GoSail_AI`
- The website indicates that business inquiries are typically answered within the same business day.

## Overall assessment

JasonZhu.AI's enterprise proposition can be summarized in three stages\:

| Business need | Service |
|--------|--------|
| Employees need to learn AI | Enterprise AI training |
| Company needs to implement AI | Consulting and development |
| Company wants to grow its AI brand | AI MCN and content marketing |


**The main differentiator** is its emphasis on practical implementation: training employees to use AI, helping businesses build AI-powered workflows and agents, and supporting AI-related brand growth.

One qualification: the published website describes these services and examples, but does not provide a comprehensive public price list or detailed contractual service packages.
